'''Template:Years or months ago''' displays the number of years (or months if less than 1 year) between a specified year/month date and the current year/month. It will also work correctly when only the year is given. Optionally, a second year/month date can be specified to be used instead of the current year/month.

This was designed as a supporting template for '''[[Template:Start date and age]]''', to be used when the specified date does not include the day of the month. The formatting of the output was designed to be similar to '''[[Template:Time ago]]'''.

{{TOC right}}

== Usage ==
For years or months before or after current date:
* <code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>Years or months ago|''year''|''month''}}</code>
* <code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>Years or months ago|''year''}}</code>

For years or months between two dates:
* <code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>Years or months ago|''year1''|''month1''|''year2''|''month2''}}</code>

== Examples ==
The following examples use {{CURRENTMONTHNAME}} {{CURRENTYEAR}} as the current month and year. If that is not correct, click the Purge link at the top of this documentation (or <span class="plainlinks">[{{fullurl:{{FULLPAGENAME}}|action=purge}} here]</span>) to update the page.

=== Year and month ===

! Template
! Output
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{Years or months ago|</nowiki>{{#expr:{{CURRENTYEAR}}-2}}&#124;{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}}}<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code>
| {{Years or months ago|{{#expr:{{CURRENTYEAR}}-2}}|{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}}}}}
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{Years or months ago|</nowiki>{{#expr:{{CURRENTYEAR}}-1}}&#124;{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}}}<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code>
| {{Years or months ago|{{#expr:{{CURRENTYEAR}}-1}}|{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}}}}}
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{Years or months ago|</nowiki>{{#ifexpr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}-2<1|{{#expr:{{CURRENTYEAR}}-2}}|{{CURRENTYEAR}}}}&#124;{{#ifexpr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}-2<1|{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}-2+12}}|{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}-2}}}}<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code>
| {{Years or months ago|{{#ifexpr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}-2<1|{{#expr:{{CURRENTYEAR}}-2}}|{{CURRENTYEAR}}}}|{{#ifexpr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}-2<1|{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}-2+12}}|{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}-2}}}}}}
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{Years or months ago|</nowiki>{{#ifexpr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}-1<1|{{#expr:{{CURRENTYEAR}}-1}}|{{CURRENTYEAR}}}}&#124;{{#ifexpr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}-1<1|{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}-1+12}}|{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}-1}}}}<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code>
| {{Years or months ago|{{#ifexpr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}-1<1|{{#expr:{{CURRENTYEAR}}-1}}|{{CURRENTYEAR}}}}|{{#ifexpr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}-1<1|{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}-1+12}}|{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}-1}}}}}}
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{Years or months ago|</nowiki>{{CURRENTYEAR}}&#124;{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}}}<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code>
| {{Years or months ago|{{CURRENTYEAR}}|{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}}}}}
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{Years or months ago|</nowiki>{{#ifexpr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}+1>12|{{#expr:{{CURRENTYEAR}}+1}}|{{CURRENTYEAR}}}}&#124;{{#ifexpr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}+1>12|{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}+1-12}}|{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}+1}}}}<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code>
| {{Years or months ago|{{#ifexpr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}+1>12|{{#expr:{{CURRENTYEAR}}+1}}|{{CURRENTYEAR}}}}|{{#ifexpr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}+1>12|{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}+1-12}}|{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}+1}}}}}}
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{Years or months ago|</nowiki>{{#ifexpr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}+2>12|{{#expr:{{CURRENTYEAR}}+2}}|{{CURRENTYEAR}}}}&#124;{{#ifexpr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}+2>12|{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}+2-12}}|{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}+2}}}}<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code>
| {{Years or months ago|{{#ifexpr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}+2>12|{{#expr:{{CURRENTYEAR}}+2}}|{{CURRENTYEAR}}}}|{{#ifexpr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}+2>12|{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}+2-12}}|{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}+2}}}}}}
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{Years or months ago|</nowiki>{{#expr:{{CURRENTYEAR}}+1}}&#124;{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}}}<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code>
| {{Years or months ago|{{#expr:{{CURRENTYEAR}}+1}}|{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}}}}}
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{Years or months ago|</nowiki>{{#expr:{{CURRENTYEAR}}+2}}&#124;{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}}}<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code>
| {{Years or months ago|{{#expr:{{CURRENTYEAR}}+2}}|{{#expr:{{CURRENTMONTH}}}}}}
|}

=== Year only (no month) ===
{| class="wikitable"
! Template
! Output
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{Years or months ago|</nowiki>{{#time:Y|now - 2 years}}}}</code>
| {{Years or months ago|{{#time:Y|now - 2 years}}}}
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{Years or months ago|</nowiki>{{#time:Y|now - 1 year}}}}</code>
| {{Years or months ago|{{#time:Y|now - 1 year}}}}
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{Years or months ago|</nowiki>{{#time:Y|now}}}}</code>
| {{Years or months ago|{{#time:Y|now}}}}
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{Years or months ago|</nowiki>{{#time:Y|now + 1 year}}}}</code>
| {{Years or months ago|{{#time:Y|now + 1 year}}}}
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{Years or months ago|</nowiki>{{#time:Y|now + 2 years}}}}</code>
| {{Years or months ago|{{#time:Y|now + 2 years}}}}
|}

* [[Template:Age]] &ndash; displays elapsed time in years (number only, future dates generate negative number)
